uplink.description: Status report, no shock alarm (motion false), normal battery, two CT entries
uplink._note: Upstream-example input (TTN netvox r900ndc codec yaml, Apache-2.0). Oracle: Volt 12, Current1 29mA, Current2 14mA, HighCurrent1Alarm 1, ShockTamperAlarm NoAlarm. Each CT input's reading and its own low/high alarm pair sit in that input's channels entry; the shock event stays whole-device.

uplink.description: Status report, shock/tamper alarm (motion true), low battery
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame: bytes[4]=0xA0 sets the low-battery high bit (3.2 V), bytes[5..7]=300 mA, bytes[8..10]=200 mA, bytes[11]=0x05 sets LowCurrent1+LowCurrent2, bytes[12]=0x01 shock alarm. expected.data authored from the upstream reference decode (Volt '3.2(low battery)', Current1 300mA, Current2 200mA, alarm flags, ShockTamperAlarm 'Alarm').

uplink.description: Status report with a distinct current and alarm pattern per CT (multi-CT)
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame giving each CT input a clearly distinct reading and alarm pair, so a per-position mix-up cannot pass: bytes[4]=0x24 -> 3.6 V, currents 1234 / 56 mA, bytes[11]=0x06 (0b0110) -> HighCurrent1Alarm + LowCurrent2Alarm, bytes[12]=0x00 no shock. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js field-for-field.

Upstream startup example is 10 bytes; right-padded to the 13-byte status-frame length so the reportType 0x00 device-info branch is exercised rather than the length guard. The four datecode bytes (25,17,18) are unchanged from the TTN example input.
